fact: The 2026 SENTAX user guide (v1.1) says taxpayers can register online, with or without a NINEA, and that a NINEA for new taxpayers is created with the ANSD and sent by a DGID agent.
title: Guide Utilisateur Adhésion et Connexion SENTAX v.1.1
publisher: Direction générale des Impôts et des Domaines (DGID)
